316626.name: Chabad of Clifton Park
316626.note: Its chabad.org listing went up 2005-09-27, so it existed by then. CrownHeights.info (15 Oct 2024): 'Eighteen years ago, Rabbi Yossi and Leah Rubin founded Clifton Park Chabad, starting with Torah Studies classes at the local library' (about 2006). The listing is earlier, so 2005, medium (sources a year apart).

321642.name: Chabad of Potomac Village
321642.note: CrownHeights.info, 6 July 2007 ('You've Got a Friend'): 'the Kaplans, after arriving in Montgomery County about two years ago' (Rabbi Mendel and Chana Kaplan, Potomac Village); its chabad.org listing went up 2005-10-21. The two agree: 2005.

452757.name: Mercaz Yisroel L'Chinuch
452757.note: CrownHeights.info, 7 Dec 2011 ('200 Step into Sarah's Tent in Flatbush'): 'Flatbush Shluchim, Rabbi Schneur Zalman and Sarah Mendelsohn ... gathered ... to celebrate twelve years since they first opened the doors to what they refer to as an Oasis of Chassidishe warmth'; 'Twelve years have whisked by, and not a day passes that one of the parents of our school won't...'. So about 1999. Counted back, so medium. Its chabad.org listing went up 2006-12-05.

1351834.name: Jewish Oasis - Chabad
1351834.note: Rabbi Chayim Eliyohu Mishulovin's center. CrownHeights.info, 6 April 2005 ('New Shluchim to Portland, Oregon'): he 'will be moving on Shlichus to Portland, Oregon where they will establish a new Chabad House [in] the downtown area'; CrownHeights.info, 2 Dec 2005: 'Rabbi Chayim Mishulovin, who moved to Portland in April with his wife Simi to run Chabad youth programs, will oversee the store's operation' (the Everything Jewish store). Its chabad.org listing (as Jewish Oasis) went up only 2010-11-24, so the name may be later: medium.

1648946.name: Chabad at Johns Hopkins Hospital
1648946.note: Lubavitch.com, 1 Dec 2016 ('Chabad at Johns Hopkins Hosts 13th Annual Dinner'): 'Rabbi Zev and Chani Gopin are the face of Chabad at this elite research hospital and university since 2003.' One later source, so medium. Its chabad.org listing went up 2011-10-17.

3828697.name: Chabad Lubavitch on the East Side
3828697.note: Its chabad.org listing went up 2017-11-06, so it existed by then. Its own site (eschabad.com, read with a plain request Nov 11): 'Ever since Chabad on the East Side opened its doors in 2018...'. The listing is earlier, so 2017, medium.

6990612.name: JRCC Willowdale
6990612.note: Its own site (read with a plain request, Nov 11): 'in September 2019 - after spending an additional year learning near the Rebbe's synagogue in Brooklyn NY and continuing his Rabbinic studies in Manhattan NY - Rabbi Yisroel and Shaina moved to the Yonge and Finch area to serve both the local and broader community'. Its chabad.org listing is from 2025.

2922904.name: Jewish Life at VCU
2922904.note: Its chabad.org listing went up 2015-04-29, so a VCU Chabad listing existed by then (a program of Chabad of Virginia). Lubavitch.com (25 Aug 2025, 'Jewish Life Thrives at VCU'): 'But in July 2024, Rabbi Menachem and Daniela Lessoff moved to Richmond to launch Jewish Life at VCU — a new Chabad on Campus center'. Whether the 2015 listing ran as a center is not found, so low.

596689.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Southern Rensselaer County
596689.note: Its chabad.org listing went up 2007-11-19, so it existed by then. Its own site's timeline (greenbushretreat.com/about, read with a plain request Nov 11): '1996 – Rabbi Avraham and Nechama Laber moved to the Capital Region Jewish community 1996 to serve as Shluchim'; '1998 – Est. The Capital Region Bat Mitzvah Club'; '2009 – Est. Chabad of S. Rensselaer County'. The listing is earlier than the 2009 of the timeline, so 2007, medium.

2948789.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Connecticut & Western Massachusetts
2948789.note: The regional office of Rabbi Yisrael and Vivi Deren. Lubavitch.com, 26 Dec 2016 ('New Center for Jewish Life Dedicated in Stamford, CT'): 'Rabbi Yisrael Deren, who founded the Chabad branch in Stamford in 1974 with his wife, Vivi'; he 'shared a letter he had received from the Lubavitcher Rebbe nearly 43 years ago to the date ... in honor of the dedication of the first Chabad he and his wife had opened in Amherst, Massachusetts' (about Dec 1973). COLlive (24 May 2024, 'The Rebbe's Child'): sent first to Amherst; Stamford came 'sixteen years later'. The region began in 1973-74: 1974, medium (sources a year apart). Its chabad.org listing went up 2015-05-13.

223137.name: Chabad of Washington Heights
223137.note: CrownHeights.info, 22 Nov 2005 ('New Shluchim to Washington Heights'): Rabbi Yackov Kirschenbaum 'will be moving on Shlichus to Washington Heights'. Its chabad.org listing went up earlier the same year (2005-01-05).

5555239.name: Troy Chabad on Campus
5555239.note: Merkos 'New Shluchim' grants (CrownHeights.info and COLlive, 19 Nov 2022; the grants go to couples in their first years): 'Shomo and Chaya Morrison, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Troy, NY'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2022-07-06. So 2022, medium (a grant list, not an opening report).

7401983.name: Cteen Raleigh
7401983.note: COLlive, 26 Aug 2019 ('New Shluchim to North Carolina'): Rabbi Mendy and Brocha Wilschanski 'have recently joined the team of Shluchim in Raleigh, NC' (Chabad of Raleigh's youth and teen work; on the Jan 2022 list of 20 new shluchim as 'Mendy Wilschanski Raleigh, NC'). The CTeen chapter's own start is not found; its chabad.org listing is only from 2026-09-16. So 2019, when its director came, low.

5574170.name: Chabad of Fishtown @ Northern Liberties
5574170.note: Its own site (read with a plain request, Nov 11): 'Rabbi Berel and Bracha Leah Paltiel moved to Fishtown August 2022 and are excited to be joining the local Jewish community.' Its domain was registered in June 2022.

1701833.name: Mercaz Menachem Chabad
1701833.note: Its chabad.org listing went up 2011-12-07, so it existed by then. Washington Jewish Week (CrownHeights.info, 28 Nov 2012, 'Chabad Father-Son Team Looks Toward Expansion'): 'In 2000, they [Rabbi Bentzion and Rebbetzin Zlata Geisinsky] left their work at the Chabad center in Potomac, to found Chabad of Bethesda-Chevy Chase'; Bentzion Geisinsky will 'eventually open a separate Chabad center in Chevy Chase', and 'the current center and the one to be developed will do business under the name Mercaz Menachem Chabad'. This Chevy Chase listing is that name: 2011 by its listing, medium (the family's work there goes back to 2000).

117657.name: Lubavitch of New Jersey Regional Hdqts.
117657.note: The regional office of Rabbi Moshe Herson. Chabad.org's obituary (CrownHeights.info, 23 Jan 2025): 'In 1960, while still a student in 770, Herson was recruited to join the staff of the Chabad yeshivah in Newark'; 'it wasn't until 1965 when Herson officially assumed the role as the Rebbe's emissary to New Jersey.' Anash.org (23 Jan 2025): 'After his chasunah, in 5725 (1965), the Rebbe appointed Rabbi Herson as his shliach to the state of New Jersey.' The Rabbinical College of America, at the same address, began in Newark in 1956 and moved to Morristown in 1971 (rca.edu); the AFL list of about 1984 has this office at 226 Sussex Ave.

117690.name: National Committee for Jewish Education
117690.note: KMR (read Nov 9, data/shetach-history.json): 'Rabbi Werner has been the director of the Monsey branch of the National Committee for the Furtherance of Jewish Education (NCFJE) since 1969'; Chabadinfo (22 Jan 2015): 'NCFJE of Rockland under the leadership of Rockland's first Shliach Rabbi Simcha Werner'. One later source for the year, so medium. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004).

117605.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Tampa Bay
117605.note: Chabad.org, 13 July 2011 ('Tampa Suburb Awaits First-Ever Synagogue'): Rabbi Yossi and Sulha Dubrowski 'have directed Chabad-Lubavitch of Tampa Bay for more than 30 years', so 1981 or a little before (counted back, medium). The AFL list of about 1984 (data/centers-1984.json) has its 'Chabad House' at 1314 No. 52nd St., Tampa; Sunbiz has CHABAD LUBAVITCH OF TAMPA, INC. (filed 22 Jan 1985) and CHABAD LUBAVITCH OF TAMPA BAY, INC. (14 March 1988), both with the Dubrowskis; today it is in Carrollwood (14908 Pennington Road).

221245.name: Chabad of the Beaches
221245.note: Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-11-11, so it existed by then. First Liberty's case page (the lawsuit filed July 2022): 'Seventeen years ago, Rabbi Eli Goodman, and his wife Beila, founded Chabad Lubavitch of the Beaches to serve the Jewish population of Long Beach Barrier Island' (about 2005; read with a plain request Nov 11); a court filing of Dec 2024 says nearly 20 years. The listing is earlier, so 2004, medium. Its synagogue merged with Temple Beth El of Long Beach (Chabad of the Beaches Beth El).
